trigger: A shared ICT, communications, control or managed-service dependency becomes unavailable or compromised.
propagation_mechanism: Correlated degradation of visibility, command, scheduling or support functions across multiple operators.
affected_sector_service: Electricity and utility operational support functions.
plausible_effects: Concurrent recovery contention, conservative operating restrictions and broader service-management demand.
early_warning_indicators: Supplier advisories; authoritative dependency disclosures; ENISA third-party compromise reporting.
assumptions: Multiple operators use a sufficiently common dependency and recovery capacity is constrained.
limitations: No named provider, probability, outage duration or loss figure is assumed.

trigger: An exposed engineering, perimeter or remote-access component supporting distributed generation is accessed.
propagation_mechanism: Altered control logic or loss of operator visibility leads to conservative operating restrictions.
affected_sector_service: Distributed generation monitoring and remote control.
plausible_effects: Loss of remote control and observability; generation may continue while operators restrict actions.
early_warning_indicators: National-authority alerts; disclosure of remote-access compromise; control-system anomaly reporting.
assumptions: Access reaches a component connected to control or monitoring pathways.
limitations: Not a claim of current European campaign, EU or UK victimisation, or successful grid disruption.

trigger: Ransomware or destructive activity affects enterprise and support networks and the operator cannot establish operational-technology separation.
propagation_mechanism: Operating restrictions coincide with restoration of trustworthy visibility and communications, then transmit through energy customers, fuel, transport, market or public-service dependencies.
affected_sector_service: Energy transport and utility support functions.
plausible_effects: Service-management pressure, recovery demand and cross-sector supply disruption.
early_warning_indicators: Public incident disclosures; public-authority measures; sector coordination notices.
assumptions: Operating restrictions are necessary while separation and system state are assessed.
limitations: No selected source establishes an equivalent September 2026 EU or UK cascade.
